Version.description: The version of ShareX this profile targets.

Name.description: The display name for the custom uploader configuration.

DestinationType.description: Type of target destination. Multiple values can be comma-separated.

RequestMethod.description: The HTTP method utilized for the primary upload request.

RequestURL.description: The destination endpoint URL where requests are processed.

Parameters.description: URL query parameters appended to the Request URL.

Headers.description: HTTP request headers (e.g., Authorization tokens, User-Agent).

Body.description: The data format format expected by the receiving endpoint.

Arguments.description: Form data payloads sent alongside the file in the request body.

FileFormName.description: The name of the multipart form field that contains the file payload data.

URL.description: The template parser syntax mapping to the direct file URL return string.

ThumbnailURL.description: The template parser syntax mapping to a small preview/thumbnail URL.

DeletionURL.description: The template parser syntax mapping to the absolute URL required to delete the resource.

ErrorMessage.description: The template parser mapping to catch system error strings from API payloads.
